cityKeyword.title: City keyword
cityKeyword.description: Filters by HealthcareFacility.Name (contains match). Leave blank to search by specialty only or broaden results.

specialtyName.title: Specialty name
specialtyName.description: Filters by Specialty.Name on active provider-specialty rows (e.g. medical oncology, gynecologic oncology). Leave blank for city-only listing.

topN.title: Max rows
topN.description: Maximum lines to return; capped at 25. Default 10 when null.
